findings.issue: מֵאֲשֶׁר is preposition + relative (from what / that which); «desde que» locks a temporal since-the-time reading.
לְחַטָּאת is the feminine noun parallel to לְעֹלָה; «pecado» names the offense and leaves the offering sense unexpressed.

notes: Person, number, and piel stem on the priest’s verbs match the tokens.
